name: fireweave-sdk-web-workspace
description: Fireweave polyglot SDK — browser workspace (package, tests, conformance)

scripts.typecheck: bun run build && tsc -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test packages/sdk/test/unit
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run conformance
